actualEntryInspections.location: Modern sales-total definition; distinguish the separate Seisenban section on the same page.
actualEntryInspections.observation: The inspected definition concerns the total money received by selling goods and supports sales revenue/takings. The other dictionary on the page also records older sell-all/receipt senses; no claim that every dictionary gives only a monetary sense.
actualEntryInspections.limits: Author fetched and inspected the actual entry; no measured spelling frequency or accounting-standard claim. The receipt is a paraphrase, not a complete dictionary reproduction.

actualEntryInspections.observation: The actual entry describes how goods sell or the condition of their selling. This supports a practical focus on sales performance rather than a sales-total definition, without banning quantitative discussion of sales performance.
actualEntryInspections.limits: Actual entry inspected, not just the navigation search summary; no assertion that the words never overlap in English sales.

actualEntryInspections.source: Kotobank encyclopedia body headed 運河 (うんが); history section credited to 山口 平四郎
actualEntryInspections.location: Opening paragraph before 運河の歴史, not the engineering/historical details.
actualEntryInspections.observation: The opening distinguishes a broad range of artificial-channel purposes, including irrigation, drainage, water supply and transport, from the article's transport-focused discussion. It acknowledges overlap between farming and boat transport.
actualEntryInspections.limits: Only the relevant opening was used. The fetched output did not expose a separate dictionary-name heading for this body, so it is not attributed to Digital Daijisen. Historical dates, engineering details and current operational status are not used.

actualEntryInspections.observation: Definition 1 describes large quantity; definition 2 describes high degree and a large comparative difference. These support the study-amount and lighter-bag examples.
actualEntryInspections.limits: The actual heading and both definitions were fetched and inspected. A web-search summary's conversational-register assertion is not adopted as a strict usage rule.
